name: voice-announcer
description: Hear when Claude finishes: a spoken "Claude has responded to chat titled …", and optionally the reply read aloud, on your Mac.
long_description:
Send a prompt, walk away, and your Mac tells you when Claude is done.

- **Announce**: says "Claude has responded to chat titled …" (and that it needs your input when Claude asked you something).
- **Read aloud**: optionally reads the reply, and any questions Claude asked, in plain spoken sentences.

It uses the Mac's built-in voice (`say`) and alert sounds. Nothing leaves your Mac and there is no network access.

**Changing settings:** click **Save** at the bottom of the settings page (you may need to scroll), or just ask Claude in a chat, for example "turn read-aloud on".

Add one line to your Claude preferences so Claude calls it each time it is about to give you its answer (see the README).

**Credits:** AI-generated. Created by Claude (Claude Opus 5.5), Anthropic's AI assistant, with Kiran Karthik Ponnusamy, who directed, tested and published it. Not an official Anthropic product.

tools.name: announce_reply
tools.description: Speaks "Claude has responded to chat titled …" and/or reads the reply aloud on your Mac.

tools.name: stop_speaking
tools.description: Stops any announcement or read-aloud that is playing.

tools.name: voice_settings
tools.description: Shows or changes the settings when you ask Claude to.

announce.title: Announce when Claude replies
announce.description: Say "Claude has responded to chat titled …" when a reply is ready. Changes on this page apply only after you click Save at the bottom (scroll down if you can't see it), or just ask Claude in a chat to change a setting.

read_reply.title: Read the reply aloud
read_reply.description: After the announcement, read Claude's reply aloud, including any questions it asks you.

stop_on_activity.title: Stop when I use the Mac
stop_on_activity.description: Stop speaking as soon as you press a key, click, or move the mouse or trackpad.

announcement.title: Announcement wording
announcement.description: What to say when a reply is ready. {title} is replaced with the chat's title.
announcement.default: Claude has responded to chat titled {title}

voice.title: Voice (optional)
voice.description: A Mac voice name such as Samantha, Daniel or Karen. Leave blank for your system voice (System Settings > Accessibility > Spoken Content).

rate.title: Speaking speed (words per minute)
rate.description: 0 keeps the voice's normal speed. Try 200 to 260 to speed it up.

chime.title: Chime before speaking
chime.description: A Mac alert sound to play first: Glass, Ping, Hero, Submarine, Tink, Pop, Purr. Type none for no chime.

max_words.title: Longest read-aloud (words)
max_words.description: Longer replies are condensed for listening; the full reply stays in the chat. 0 means no limit. Remember to click Save below to apply your changes.
